description: Scan audience comments/DMs/forums for recurring frustrations. Map each pain to content pillar. Extract 3 angles per pain. Works for any channel.
output_pattern: pain points → pillar mapping → 3 content angles

description: Find trending topic in your industry. Connect it to your expertise/experience. Ride the wave before it crashes.
output_pattern: trending topic → your angle → timely content

description: Start from YOUR experience. Ask: what did I learn? Who else needs this? What format fits best?
output_pattern: experience → lesson → audience → format

description: Take popular advice in your niche. Question it. Find where it breaks. Write the counter-argument.
output_pattern: popular belief → holes → your take

description: Collect questions people ask you repeatedly (DMs, meetings, mentoring). Each question = 1 post.
output_pattern: repeated questions → answer posts

description: Combine 2 unrelated pillars (e.g., PM + music, startup + cricket). Unexpected combos create viral potential.
output_pattern: pillar A + pillar B → unexpected angle

description: Pick 3-5 top creators in your niche. Analyze their top 10 posts. What patterns emerge? Replicate the pattern not the content.
output_pattern: competitors → top posts → patterns → your version

description: Read comments on viral posts in your niche. People reveal real opinions objections stories in comments. Each gold comment = content seed.
output_pattern: viral post → comments → insights → content seeds

description: Find 1 surprising stat about your topic. Build entire content around that single data point. Stats stop the scroll.
output_pattern: topic → surprising stat → context → take

description: Study exact words your audience uses to describe their problems. Use THEIR words not industry jargon. Resonance > sophistication.
output_pattern: audience words → mirror in content → instant relatability

description: Weekly scan: Google Trends Twitter trending LinkedIn news Reddit threads newsletter opens. Map what is hot to your pillars.
output_pattern: platforms → trending topics → pillar fit → content queue

description: Find what top creators in your niche are NOT talking about. The gap = your opportunity. Underserved topics = lower competition higher loyalty.
output_pattern: niche scan → missing topics → your blue ocean

description: Write same hook in 5 different styles (question bold data story confession). Pick the one with maximum curiosity gap for target channel.
output_pattern: topic → 5 hooks → evaluate → winner

description: Craft exactly 2 lines that force the reader to click see more. Line 1 = setup. Line 2 = incomplete payoff. The gap does the work.
output_pattern: setup → incomplete payoff → curiosity gap

description: Break the expected feed pattern. If everyone writes long go ultra-short. If everyone is positive go raw honest. Scroll stops at surprise.
output_pattern: feed norm → opposite → attention

description: Replace vague hooks with hyper-specific details. Not 'I failed' but 'I lost Rs 4.7 lakhs in 47 days'. Specifics = credibility = clicks.
output_pattern: vague → specific numbers/names/dates → trust

description: Start by calling out exactly who should read this. 'If you are a PM who...' Self-identification makes people feel personally addressed.
output_pattern: target identity → their specific pain → pull

description: Start with the END of the story. 'That one decision made me Rs 20L.' Reader needs to know HOW. Do not close the loop until the end.
output_pattern: result first → mystery → reveal at end

description: Connect personal experience to universal insight. MY story → YOUR takeaway. The bridge between 'this happened to me' and 'this matters to you'.
output_pattern: personal → bridge → universal takeaway

description: Every good post needs tension. Setup the stakes early. What could go wrong? What was at risk? No tension = no engagement.
output_pattern: stakes → rising tension → resolution → lesson

description: Replace 'I was scared' with 'My hands were shaking on the keyboard at 2 AM'. Sensory details > abstract emotions. Works for any format.
output_pattern: abstract emotion → concrete scene → reader feels it

description: Resist the urge to cover 5 things. One clear point deeply explored. Reader should be able to summarize your post in 1 sentence.
output_pattern: multiple ideas → pick ONE → go deep → clarity

description: Start and end with the same image/phrase/scene but with changed meaning. Creates satisfying closure.
output_pattern: opening image → journey → same image new meaning

description: Start as the villain or victim of your own story. Then flip to hero through self-awareness. Relatable > aspirational.
output_pattern: villain/victim → realization → growth → hero

description: One idea flows down: long-form blog → LinkedIn post → carousel slides → reel script → tweet thread → email newsletter. Single input 6 outputs.
output_pattern: idea → expand → compress → visualize → micro → email

description: Take an existing post that performed well. Rewrite in completely different format. Story that worked? Make it a listicle.
output_pattern: top post → new format → fresh reach

description: Same message native to each platform's culture. LinkedIn = professional insight. Instagram = visual + casual. Substack = deep dive. Not copy-paste — translate.
output_pattern: core message → platform culture → native version

description: Posts older than 90 days with high engagement = recyclable. Update with new data/experience. Repost. Your new audience hasn't seen it.
output_pattern: old top post → update → new context → repost

description: Take a multi-point post/thread. Pick the ONE point that got most comments. Expand just that into full standalone content.
output_pattern: multi-point → top comment point → expand → standalone

description: Someone asks you a great question in comments/DMs. Your reply = next post. The question becomes the hook. Built-in social proof.
output_pattern: DM/comment question → hook → detailed answer post

description: Find the sweet spot between 'everyone agrees' (boring) and 'everyone is offended' (toxic). Mildly controversial = most comments.
output_pattern: safe take → find edge → calibrate → debate magnet

description: Design the post so people HAVE to respond. Leave a gap. Ask 'what would you do?' Make them complete YOUR sentence.
output_pattern: statement → intentional gap → reader fills it

description: Write for a specific tribe. 'Only PMs will understand this.' Exclusivity drives shares within the tribe. People tag their people.
output_pattern: tribe identity → insider reference → tag behavior

description: Your first comment on your own post = engagement hack. Add context ask a follow-up share a bonus tip. Kickstarts the comment thread.
output_pattern: post live → self-comment → conversation starter

description: Make content people bookmark/save. Frameworks checklists templates cheat sheets. Saves signal 'high value' to algorithms across all platforms.
output_pattern: actionable content → structured format → save trigger

description: Place your most emotional line at 60-70% through the post. Reader is invested by then. That is where the Hindi line the emoji the gut punch lands hardest.
output_pattern: buildup → peak at 60-70% → release → CTA

description: You are not just 'a PM'. You are 'IIT Civil Eng → Amex PM → startup investor'. The intersection of your identities IS your brand. Nobody else has your exact combination.
output_pattern: identity 1 + identity 2 + identity 3 → unique position

description: Do not be the expert who has all answers. Be the practitioner who shares what they are learning. 'I am figuring this out too' > 'Let me teach you'.
output_pattern: expert pedestal → come down → peer level → trust

description: Create ONE framework people associate with YOU. Name it. Use it repeatedly. Owned IP = brand moat.
output_pattern: your process → name it → repeat → people cite you

description: Every few weeks re-anchor to your origin story. New followers do not know you. Context makes every other post hit harder.
output_pattern: origin story → periodically retell → new audience context

description: Have a consistent voice but vary content types. Always sound like YOU but surprise with format. Predictable voice unpredictable content.
output_pattern: consistent tone → varied format → familiarity + surprise

description: Share the messy middle not just polished results. Real-time > highlight reel.
output_pattern: real-time update → raw truth → audience invests in journey

description: Each platform has peak engagement windows. Test 3 time slots for 2 weeks. Let data decide YOUR golden hour.
output_pattern: platform defaults → test 3 slots → measure → your golden hour

description: First 60 minutes after posting = critical. Stay online. Reply to EVERY comment within minutes. Algorithm sees early engagement burst → pushes to more feeds.
output_pattern: post → 60 min active → reply all → algorithm boost

description: Post on primary platform. Then seed it elsewhere. Screenshot LinkedIn post → Instagram story. Drive traffic both ways.
output_pattern: primary post → screenshot/quote → seed on others → cross traffic

description: Before posting DM 5-10 people who would genuinely care about the topic. Personal touch → guaranteed early engagement.
output_pattern: draft ready → 5-10 DMs → genuine interest → early comments

description: Start content where friction is lowest. Tweet the idea. If traction → LinkedIn post. If that works → Substack deep dive. Let audience validate before you invest more effort.
output_pattern: micro test → validate → expand → invest more

description: Create 5 posts in one creative session. Schedule across the week. Creative energy is bursty. Distribution should be consistent.
output_pattern: batch create → queue → drip publish → consistency

description: Every post that underperforms — WHY? Weak hook? Wrong time? Too long? No CTA? Diagnose ONE cause. Fix it in next post. Never repeat the same death.
output_pattern: underperforming post → diagnose → one fix → apply next

description: Every month line up your top 5 posts. What do they share? Same hook style? Same pillar? Same length? The pattern IS your playbook.
output_pattern: top 5 → common traits → pattern → double down

description: Track when engagement peaks and drops off. If comments die after 4 hours your audience is morning-only. Behavior > vanity metrics.
output_pattern: time-series data → decay curve → audience behavior insight

description: Track which hook/narrative/CTA/tone combos produce highest engagement. After 30 posts you will know YOUR winning formula.
output_pattern: hook × narrative × CTA × tone → engagement → ranked combos

description: When you gain followers trace back — which post brought them? Which posts lose followers? The delta tells you what attracts vs repels.
output_pattern: follower spikes → source post → attract patterns → repel patterns

description: If same format keeps working but engagement slowly drops — audience fatigue. Track engagement trend PER FORMAT over months.
output_pattern: format → monthly engagement trend → plateau signal → rotate

description: Set artificial constraints. 'Write this in exactly 5 lines.' '100 words only.' 'No I/me.' Constraints force creativity. Freedom paralyzes.
output_pattern: topic → add constraint → forced creativity → surprising output

description: Write your post from someone else's POV. Your manager. Your intern. Your user. Your competitor. Your mother reading your LinkedIn.
output_pattern: your topic → someone else's eyes → new angle

description: Write a letter to past-you or future-you about this topic. Emotional distance creates clarity.
output_pattern: topic → past/future self → letter format → emotional depth

description: Find a great post from a DIFFERENT industry. Steal its structure replace with your content. Structure travels content doesn't.
output_pattern: other industry post → extract structure → apply your topic

description: Write the post. Then flip it. If you started with lesson start with story. The inverted version is often better because it surprises even you.
output_pattern: first draft → invert structure/tone → compare → pick better

description: Best ideas come when you are NOT creating. Gym shower walk chai break. Keep a capture system. Raw thoughts > forced brainstorming.
output_pattern: random moment → capture immediately → review weekly → refine into post
